weekly: Introduction: What is Foreign Policy? • Theme: Defining foreign policy; methods of study; Türkiye’s FP foundations. • Guiding Questions: How does foreign policy differ from domestic politics? What makes Turkish Foreign Policy distinctive? Core Readings • Walter Carlsnaes (2002), “Foreign Policy” general principles. • Binnur Özkeçeci-Taner & Sinem Akgül Açıkmeşe (2023), “Historical and Theoretical Aspects of Turkey’s Foreign Policy” (Chapter 1, One Hundred Years of Turkish Foreign Policy) • William Hale, Turkish Foreign Policy since 1774 → Introduction. • Baskın Oran (ed.), Turkish Foreign Policy, 1919–2006 → Introductory section. Recommended / Optional • James Rosenau (1966), “Pre-theories and Theories of Foreign Policy.” • James Rosenau (2006), “Pre-theorizing Foreign Policy in a Globalized World.” • Graham Allison, “Conceptual Models and the Cuban Missile Crisis.” (for the three decision-making models) • Goldstein & Pevehouse, Foreign Policy (individuals, groups, bureaucracies) • Bill Park, Modern Turkey: People, State and Foreign Policy in a Globalised World (domestic–foreign entanglement) • Filiz Coban Oran, Religion, Nationalism and Foreign Policy → Introduction (identity/discourse lens)

Historical Foundations I: Ottoman Legacy & Early Republic • Theme: Ottoman diplomacy, Lausanne, and the early Republic’s “foreign policy of survival.” • Guiding Questions: How did the Ottoman legacy shape the Republic? How did Lausanne define Türkiye’s external orientation? • Preparation: Reflect on the role of nationalism, secularism, and minorities.

Historical Foundations II: Cold War & Alignment with the West • Theme: NATO membership, the U.S. alliance, Cyprus crises. • Guiding Questions: Was Türkiye a loyal or reluctant ally? How did Cyprus reshape its Western orientation? • Preparation: Consider alliance theory and autonomy vs dependence.

Theoretical Approaches to Turkish Foreign Policy • Theme: Realism, liberalism, constructivism, critical approaches, and role theory. • Guiding Questions: Which theory best explains Turkish Foreign Policy? How does identity interact with theory? • Preparation: Apply different theories to Türkiye’s behaviour toward neighbours.

Türkiye–U.S. Relations & NATO • Theme: Strategic bargains, crises, and endurance of the alliance. • Guiding Questions: Why has NATO remained central despite recurrent crises? How do betrayal narratives shape Turkish identity? • Preparation: Think about entrapment vs abandonment in alliance politics.
